_comment_macros: Single SRAM macro. Volare cache paths inside Docker container.
_comment_floorplan: 2000x2000 µm die. One 480x398 µm macro in the lower-left corner; rest is open compute area. Plenty of routing headroom; trivially low congestion expected.
_comment_sta: Limit STA to the nominal corner only — multi-corner STA exhausted RAM in the 16-macro run (SIGKILL after 7h). Single-corner closure is sufficient for the M4 deliverable.
_comment_signoff: Magic DRC disabled: Magic crashes reading sky130 SRAM GDS (unknown layer/datatype for openram_dp_cell* subcells — known sky130+Magic incompatibility). Routing DRC clean (0 errors after macro moved to y=200). KLayout XOR passes. LVS runs via netgen, unaffected.
_comment_pdn_halo: Keep PDN straps 10 µm away from macro edges to avoid met4 short/spacing violations at macro boundary.
